title: YEARFRAC defaults to the US 30/360 basis

source.supports: the example shows 0.9556 for these dates on basis 0 (US 30/360)
basis 0 is the default; Return value: a decimal number

derivation: On a 30/360 basis January 1 to December 15 is 11 months of 30 days plus 14 days = 344 days; 344 / 360 = 0.95555..., which the page prints as 0.9556.
